scope: Primary-source repository and packaging survey for makOS app mechanisms; no implementation, clone, build, install or runtime validation performed.

source_inventory.source: GitHub connector search_repositories org=linuxdeepin per_page=100, pages 1-3

interpretation.source_candidate: An actual public application/mechanism was identified; integration and complete feature parity are not established.
interpretation.no_suitable_public_repo_verified: No suitable repository found in the bounded official-organization survey, not an assertion that no software exists elsewhere.
interpretation.activity: archived is the GitHub flag. Head commit time and repository push time are recorded separately; neither alone is a maintenance guarantee.
interpretation.licenses: README declarations and GitHub detection only; per-file and bundled dependency licenses require review before redistribution.
interpretation.dependencies: Prefer current debian/control over stale README Qt5 lists. Most inspected active application packages now target Qt6/DTK6, while voice-note/game README/package paths may remain Qt5.
interpretation.shipped_vs_source: Findings describe current public sources. This survey does not claim these exact revisions shipped in the previously inspected Deepin ISO.

applications.purpose: File operations, search, Trash, archives, properties; reusable I/O, mount and search libraries.
applications.limitations: Source candidate for mechanisms. DDE shell/services and Qt6/DTK6 integration need adaptation; no Tahoe UI/animation parity established.

applications.purpose: Modular settings frontend plus session/system settings services.
applications.limitations: Current control-center packaging couples to dde-services, DDE shell, Treeland protocols and system privileges; not a drop-in generic Settings backend.

applications.purpose: Official named repository exists.
applications.limitations: Default branch contains only README.md (39 bytes, TODO); no renderer or complete browser implementation available in this repo.

applications.purpose: Related repos checked to avoid false matches.
applications.limitations: dde-cooperation handles file transfer/device cooperation; deepin-im is an input method. Neither supplies a verified messaging service/client.

applications.purpose: deepin-mail is listed in an official Deepin non-free package index.
applications.limitations: No suitable public source repository located in the audited linuxdeepin inventory; engine and reuse license not established.

applications.purpose: No corresponding maps/navigation project found.
applications.limitations: Bounded to the audited official organization; not a claim about all Linux mapping software.

applications.purpose: Album photo timelines, collections/albums; viewer for image display.
applications.limitations: Qt6/DTK6 and EXIF/RAW/image-format components; no iCloud Photos or complete Apple Photos feature equivalence established.

applications.purpose: No matching video-call backend/client found.
applications.limitations: Device cooperation is not a verified video-call backend; no FaceTime protocol interoperability established.

applications.purpose: Official non-free index includes deepin-phone-assistant.
applications.limitations: Name alone does not establish telephony/SMS functionality; no suitable public counterpart or reusable calling backend verified.

applications.purpose: Calendar events/scheduling with alarm-manager and CalDAV account-sync source.
applications.limitations: CalDAV API/source was inspected; no server interoperability or runtime test performed. README app license is GPL-3.0-or-later; inspected alarm/CalDAV headers carry LGPL-3.0-or-later.

applications.purpose: Schedule alarm manager supports event notifications and remind-later operations.
applications.limitations: No standalone task-list app or full Reminders counterpart verified; bundled kcalendarcore Todo class alone does not prove an exposed task product.

applications.purpose: Text notes and voice recordings; SQLite and audio libraries in packaging.
applications.limitations: Suitable notes/audio mechanisms, but complete Apple Notes rich-content, sync and collaboration parity unverified.

applications.purpose: No standalone address-book/contacts backend found.
applications.limitations: Bounded to audited public organization; contacts support inside closed packages not assessed.

applications.purpose: Local music player; Qt6/DTK6, VLC/FFmpeg, TagLib and MPRIS dependencies.
applications.limitations: Local playback candidate, not an Apple Music subscription/catalog service.

applications.purpose: Gomoku and tile-matching puzzle games.
applications.limitations: Individual games, not a Games/Game Center library, achievements or account service.

applications.purpose: APT/D-Bus package/update service; official Deepin Store product supports app browsing/installing/rating.
applications.limitations: lastore-daemon is not the store GUI/catalog. Store package is listed in non-free index; suitable public storefront source not located.

applications.purpose: Real terminal emulator with workspaces, windows and remote management; bundled terminalwidget backend.
applications.limitations: Qt6 preferred/Qt5 fallback in current CMake; backend extraction and Linux PTY behavior still need integration testing.

applications.purpose: Calculator application with Qt6/DTK6 packaging.
applications.limitations: A calculator mechanism candidate; Apple Math Notes/unit-conversion feature parity not assessed.

applications.purpose: Gomoku is available as a board game.
applications.limitations: Gomoku/five-in-a-row is not western chess; no exact Chess engine/application found in the audited organization.

applications.purpose: USB camera photos/videos; README identifies Guvcview heritage; current packaging uses Qt6, FFmpeg and GStreamer.
applications.limitations: Camera capture candidate; Photo Booth filters/layout/animation equivalence not established.

applications.purpose: Region recording with stop/save UI; current Qt6/Wayland, FFmpeg and GStreamer dependencies.
applications.limitations: Wayland compositor/portal compatibility must be validated on makOS; no tested drop-in integration.

applications.purpose: A/B root filesystem backup/rollback service using rsync and GRUB.
applications.limitations: Requires current/candidate root partitions plus /boot and /home. Design excludes /home from root copy, so this does not supply Time Machine-like personal-file history. Last default-branch commit 2023; non-archived is not proof of active maintenance.

applications.purpose: Historical OS-installer sources linked by official site; current .deb package installer and bootable-USB writer also exist.
applications.limitations: Official legacy installer links redirect to archived martyr-deepin projects. deepin-deb-installer installs packages, and deepin-boot-maker writes boot media; neither is a complete current OS installer.

integration_note: Treat Deepin components as backend/library/service candidates behind a unified makOS frontend. Reskinning an app does not create Tahoe behavior or Apple service compatibility.
